$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is the bundle with known gaps audited correctly, and it is the run
every other gapped case is a single deviation from. Security passes on evidence that meets every stated
requirement, performance is CONCERNS because no target exists to judge a healthy load test against,
reliability is FAIL because a stated error-rate ceiling is breached, and maintainability is CONCERNS
because the coverage threshold is stated and the report for it is not in the bundle.
The report is CONSTRUCTED, following nfr-report-template.md's section order and its Gate YAML snippet.
derivation: Domain statuses roll up from the findings inside each section, worst first.
Performance: four CONCERNS, so CONCERNS. Security: four PASS and one N/A, and N/A never wins, so PASS.
Reliability: five PASS and one FAIL, so FAIL. Maintainability: two CONCERNS and two PASS, so CONCERNS.
All four match the ground truth, so there are no status misses and neither undecidable domain was passed.
Coverage: four headings, four of them stating a readable status.
Thresholds: security names 0 critical, reliability names 0.5%, maintainability names 80%, and performance
records UNKNOWN, which is what a bundle stating no target owes. 4 of 4.
Overall: the Gate YAML says FAIL, which is what a FAIL domain rolls up to. Unknown threshold: the document
carries the word, which the gapped bundle expects.
Evidence: nineteen citations over six distinct files, one per Evidence line, and every one of them is a file the
bundle carries, so nothing is fabricated. Per section and in report order: the load test on all four performance
dimensions; the security review on authentication, authorization, data protection and compliance, with the
dependency scan on vulnerability management; the observability export on all six reliability dimensions; and the
tech spec on coverage and duplication, the dependency scan on the vulnerability scan, and the logging config on
observability. One evidence gap is listed, for the missing coverage report.
That reliability list is the one gapped-fault-tolerance-grounded-on-spec changes, at its fourth entry and nowhere
else. The two cases agree on every other field of the stored result, which is what makes the pair the check on
signatureOf's contract.
cleanFalsePositives is 0 because this is not the clean bundle.
Duplicate sections: none. Every domain this report assesses has exactly one section.

unknownThreshold.field: a threshold is recorded as UNKNOWN
